The Covid-19 pandemic impacted the music and arts community particularly hard. Musicians who had previously been interviewed for the Fillius Jazz Archive graciously shared their experiences during this virtual shutdown period. The political and racial unrest occurring simultaneously was also addressed.
Ken was interviewed via Zoom on June 9, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very happy to have Ken Peplowski in New York City as my guest. And I would pull a mean one on you and ask for the exact date and location of when we first had an interview. But I won’t do that.
Well wait a minute now. Was it Odessa, Texas?
It was not, but it was sort of like that. It was in Aspen 23 years ago almost.
